verdicts.reason: A: the headline is strong, but the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-right corner. The ingredient pills are split unevenly (2 left, 3 right), their text is tiny, the CTA is small next to the pills around it, and the two-line legal text is unreadable at this size. B has the same tiny logo and unreadable legal text, and its layout is worse. Its pills are ragged and badly aligned (Wild Honey sits offset in the lower-left), and the CTA butts right up against the Wild Honey pill, so the button nearly collides with it and loses its prominence.
